page_title: LIV 4-1 IPS | Liverpool v Ipswich 25/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Michael Salisbury is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Ipswich.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' 4 - 1 Jacob Greaves (Ipswich) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the right side of the goal. The score is 4:1.
90' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Ipswich will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
86' Here comes a substitution. Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) is brought on as a substitute for Luis Diaz.
85' It will be a corner kick for Liverpool.
84' What a save from Alisson! George Hirst (Ipswich) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
81' Yellow card. Julio Enciso (Ipswich) goes into the referee's book after a bad challenge.
81' Wataru Endo (Liverpool) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
80' Arne Slot has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jayden Danns (Liverpool) replacing Alexis Mac Allister.
79' The manager makes a subsitution with Julio Enciso (Ipswich) coming on for Omari Hutchinson.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Liam Delap leaves the pitch and George Hirst (Ipswich) comes on.
79' Substitution. Nathan Broadhead (Ipswich) replaces Jaden Philogene.
75' Liam Delap (Ipswich) gets booked for the first time in this match.
75' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) goes for goal but he directs his effort just wide of the left post.
75' Liverpool have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
71' Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the right post.
68' Substitution. Ryan Gravenberch is replaced by Wataru Endo (Liverpool).
68' Arne Slot has decided to substitute Cody Gakpo and he is replaced by Darwin Nunez (Liverpool).
68' A substitution has been made. Dominik Szoboszlai goes off and Harvey Elliott (Liverpool) comes on.
68' Michael Salisbury sticks with his original decision after the VAR review. No infringement and the goal stands!
67' Wait! Referee Michael Salisbury has indicated he is going to review the Liverpool goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
66' 4 - 0 Goal! Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) makes the score 4:0 after burying a close-range header in the left side of the goal after a good run and cross by Trent Alexander-Arnold.
64' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
63' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
62' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
61' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) hits a shot towards the left side of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Alisson.
60' Ipswich take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

60' A lofted cross from Benjamin Johnson (Ipswich) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Ipswich.
59' Conor Townsend (Ipswich) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
58' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
55' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Christian Walton, who smothers the ball.
54' Jaden Philogene (Ipswich) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
51' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
46' The game is over for Leif Davis (Ipswich). Conor Townsend comes on for the second half.
46' Michael Salisbury blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+8' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+7' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) latches onto a decent pass, but flashes his shot just wide of the left post.
45+6' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Luis Diaz, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
45+4' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
45+3' Ibrahima Konate (Liverpool) makes a strong challenge and Michael Salisbury blows for a foul.
45' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' 3 - 0 Goal! The rebound fell to Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) and he fired home from close range. The score is 3:0.

44' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) was close to scoring a goal after unleashing a first-time effort from inside the six-yard box. The ball was aimed towards the middle of the net, but the goalkeeper read it well and pulled off a brilliant save to thwart the attempt.
43' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
40' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
39' Omari Hutchinson (Ipswich) was too forceful with his tackle and Michael Salisbury interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Liverpool are awarded the free kick.

35' 2 - 0 Cody Gakpo sends a precise lofted cross into the box. Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) latches on to it and finishes with a quick shot into the top of the net. The goalkeeper had no chance. The score changes to 2:0.
34' Half-chance! Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) plays a pass into the box, but Christian Walton reacts well to snuff out the attack.
33' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Christian Walton intercepts the ball.
29' Kieran McKenna is forced to make a change. Wes Burns (Ipswich) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Benjamin Johnson.
24' Wes Burns (Ipswich) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
24' The attempt by Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) isn't very precise and Christian Walton stops it with ease.
22' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) unleashes a decent shot towards goal from long range, but his effort just misses the target.
20' Ipswich fail to score from a corner as Alisson (Liverpool) leaps to collect the ball.
19' Wes Burns (Ipswich) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Ipswich will have a corner.
15' Trent Alexander-Arnold (Liverpool) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
11' 1 - 0 Goal! Ibrahima Konate tees up Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) on the edge of the box and he fires the ball into the bottom right corner. 1:0.
9' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ipswich.
7' Andrew Robertson (Liverpool) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
2' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Liverpool will take the kick-off.
Michael Salisbury is the one to supervise the game today.
